entry.title: You Don’t Need a Bigger Model — You Need a Stable One
entry.summary: Every few months, a new model drops. More parameters. And developers rush to integrate it. But here’s the uncomfortable truth: Most AI apps don’t fail because the model isn’t powerful enough. They fail because the system isn’t stable. There’s a difference.
